sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Fast funding (typically next business day), no impact on personal credit score, automated repayment that adjusts to daily sales, integrated with Stripe account, simple application process.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Stripe Capital provides fast, flexible financing in the form of business loans and merchant cash advances, designed to help small businesses manage cash flow and invest in growth. It offers a simple application process, quick funding, and automated repayment based on a percentage of daily sales.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Flat fee, automated repayment as a fixed percentage of daily sales

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Small businesses, businesses using Stripe for payment processing
